reviews.x: Got this today. Used right away! Love this!! Powerful and not loud. I was able to remove 3 coats of color change gel off with out damaging my nails or my gel builder and tips! It takes a  couple nails  to find the right speed but once done ,your right on track!
Awesome drill! Be careful! If you press too heavy, you will nip yourself or file your nail beds too much!

I was worried that this machine would be hard to use, but it's AMAZING!!!! My nails came out smooth and I had big lumps of acrylic on my nails. The machine is super easy to use and I love the reverse options. I would definitely recommend this!!!

Way better than I thought it would be in weight, power, everything! Happy customer! Perfect for acrylic nails or gels. Don't waste your money on expensive ones unless you need more horsepower for longevity if you are doing nails everyday for a business, and even then this would work well until it gets old. Thank you seller!

I feel like a pro using this! Follow instructions for safety and not to mess up equipment. It's wonderful for the price, the quality that you get, with all the wonderful settings. I'd buy again. It saves me so much time and hassle to thin coat before soaking off gel polish.

I LOVEEEE my nail drill. I bought this item to start my journey as a self taught nail tech and it’s the best $25.00-$30.00 I’ve ever spent. & It has a switch to change the spin rotation (didn’t realize how much it makes a difference lol). It removes gel polish with ease & I’ve seen reviews that it stops working after a few times but I’m 50 full sets in and it’s still working like the day it was delivered. I’m a very satisfied customer and whatever year this one gives up.. I WILL be buying the sa

I bought this in the warehouse, I immediately opened it and started using it. It works great. Looks good, as good as brand new. It seems strong and the bits work good, stay in  well. I saw other reviews that the bits fell out. Mine works great.  It is only a week old to me, but great so far. I love playing with my nails at home, saves a lot of money. This was worth the money.

I've started doing my own nails at home and I was spending a long time filing and shaping my acrylics. This has made it so much easier. I'm a beginner so I'm still getting the hang of all the attachments and how to use them but i don't spend as long filing my nails now.

When I moved from Cali to AZ I was desperately searching for a mobile manicurist which, sadly, is VERY hard to find. Bought this machine to use on myself, so glad I did. Same machine the nail techs use. Great price for quality product!
This nail drill with bits worked just like the nail drills in the salon.  I'm a believer.
Love very quiet works wonderfully so far so good

I bought this in February and it stopped workin last month (may) it was amazing before it just stopped spinning. I even cleaned it out because I assumed it might have dust built up but that wasn’t the case. The light on the main box with the controls comes on but when I flip the on switch on the drill itself it won’t spin anymore. It looks like it’s trying but it never can. When this first happened it slowed down while spinner but this time it won’t even do a slow spin. Seems like it’s stuck. I’

reviews.t: DO NOT RECOMMEND. WASTE OF TIME AND MONEY
reviews.x: I was really excited to get this. Turned it on and made it through 3 nails with the knob a little less than half way up (about 7 minutes)... It shut off. The green light was still on, but nothing. More than an hour later I tried it again and nothing. The power light will come on, but that's it. DO NOT RECOMMEND. WASTE OF TIME AND MONEY! I also have to pay shipping to return this defective item. VERY DISAPPOINTING.

reviews.t: I’m in love with this nail drill !! ❤️
reviews.x: I’ve been doing my own nails for a while now and I was in need of a new nail drill because my other one didn’t work anymore. It just arrived today in the mail and I was just so excited to try this!!! It works great & I love it so much 😭😭💓 so if you’re on a budget and need a nail drill buy this one, I’m pleasantly surprised at how amamzing this one works! I’ll definitely buy it again

reviews.t: Worked great the first few times but then the power slowed ...
reviews.x: Worked great the first few times but then the power slowed down. Still works but not like it did at first. It fits nicely in my hand (small hands), doesn't make a lot of noise or vibrate and move around. If it just kept the original speed it would be the perfect machine.

reviews.t: I liked that the product was shipped promptly
reviews.x: I liked that the product was shipped promptly. But I do have to say that when I first used this product it worked wonderful but the second time I tried to turn it on it would  turn on are all. So I am returning it and hopefully to get my money back.
Amazing product. Will never waste money on  a professional drill at beauty supply

reviews.t: Less than a year and it stopped working!!
reviews.x: I greatly enjoyed this nail drill, till now. I switched the polarity of the drill to do my Left hand and it stopped working all together. This caused my application of a new set to take twice as long to finish, do to the fact that I had to hand file the other half of my nails. I purchased the drill, November 6th and it hasn’t even been a year, but enough time has past that I can’t return it for a new drill. $20 down the drain, hoping I can find a better one for a decent price. I guess I paid for

This nail drill works great! The only down fall is that I had to buy two because my puppy chewed the cord on the first one however it was an actual blessing. The first nail drill I received came with the wrong bit I think, when I'd use the bit that the sandpaper goes on it would ALWAYS slide off anytime I turned the drill on but I thought "hey it was only $20" then the dog chewed it and I bought another one but this time the bit had ridges on it which held the sandpaper in place! Perfect the 2nd

reviews.t: ... only used it once so far but it works great. it is very quiet
reviews.x: I've only used it once so far but it works great. it is very quiet, and I like that you can adjust the speed because it takes some getting used to if you've never used a nail drill before. I use this to take off the top layer of my gel polish before I put it in my nail steamer with acetone to soften it. Better than soaking for 15-20 minutes. I just hope it doesn't break down on me, but it seems like a good product.

Only used it 2x in almost 2 years. I have a regular nail person and bought this when I thought I would do my own. Well here we are on quarantine from. COVID-19 and I haven’t seen my guy in over 2 months. I used it 3 times in the last week and now it’s dead. Great!!! Ordering something different from a different seller. Can you imagine if I really used this on a regular?

reviews.t: !!BUY AT YOUR OWN RISK! Mines died. Brand Subay !!
reviews.x: DEAD..DEAD. DEAD.. My unit died two weeks ago Not even two months of use and it died. I was hesitant to purchase because some of the reviews said they too used it once or twice and it DIED.  I would NOT purchase this product. I now have to take my hard earned money and buy from a new seller. Unfair !

reviews.t: Extra long cords for easy use
reviews.x: This thing is absolutely incredible. It's made doing my nails, which I have done on my own for years, so much easier. So far I haven't had any of the issues a few others have mentioned, but at this price and as well as it works, I'd be perfectly happy getting a new one every year!

I had a drill exactly like this, I believe it was the same one for over a year so when it stopped working I ordered this one expecting to get another year or so out of it, it stopped working in the middle of my second use. I will be returning this and looking for a new e-file.

reviews.t: Broke after 3 uses, not worth the money.
reviews.x: Drill works great, while it works. I used it 3 times and it stopped turning on altogether. The 3 times I used it was just to drill off my gel topcoat so im sure it would have broken even faster if I had used it heavily.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the drill as powerful, effective, and great value for the price, with many saying it performs like a salon machine.
Users find it easy to use and beginner-friendly, though some note it takes a little practice to find the right speed and attachments.
Several reviewers describe it as quiet and low-vibration.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with the device stopping or slowing down after a short period of use.
Some users caution that pressing too hard can damage nails or cause nips, so care is needed.
